items.stem: A project reports BCWP (EV) = 400, ACWP (AC) = 500. What does this indicate about cost performance?

options.text: It is over budget for the work performed (CPI < 1)
options.rationale: Correct: CPI = EV/AC = 400/500 = 0.8 < 1, so the project is over budget for the work done.
CPI is 0.8, which is below 1, so it is over budget, not under.
On budget would require EV = AC; here they differ.
CPI is directly computable from EV and AC.

items.explanation: Correct: CPI = EV/AC = 400/500 = 0.8 < 1, so the project is over budget for the work done.

items.stem: Which estimate class is generally the most accurate and prepared when project definition is most complete?

options.text: A definitive (lowest-class-number) estimate with high project definition
options.rationale: Correct: the most definitive estimate classes are prepared at high project definition and have the narrowest accuracy range.

options.text: An order-of-magnitude estimate at concept stage
options.rationale: Order-of-magnitude estimates are the least defined and least accurate.

options.text: Any estimate made early in the project
options.rationale: Early estimates are less defined and less accurate.

options.text: A verbal estimate with no basis
options.rationale: An unsupported verbal figure is not a defensible estimate class.

items.explanation: Correct: the most definitive estimate classes are prepared at high project definition and have the narrowest accuracy range.

items.stem: Which TWO are appropriate components of contingency in a cost estimate? (Select TWO)

options.text: An allowance for identified risks that may occur
options.rationale: Correct: contingency covers identified risk events that may materialize.

options.text: An allowance for estimating uncertainty within defined scope
options.rationale: Correct: contingency addresses uncertainty/variability within the current scope.

options.text: Funding for a major scope change the client has requested
options.rationale: Approved scope changes are handled by change management, not contingency.

options.text: Deliberate padding to inflate the budget
options.rationale: Arbitrary padding is not a legitimate, defensible contingency basis.
Taxes are direct estimated costs, not contingency.

items.explanation: Correct: contingency covers identified risk events that may materialize.
